blocks.text: You’ll need a commodity code when you fill in a customs declaration form, so you pay the correct amount of tax and duties.

Trade Tariff: look up commodity codes, duty and VAT rates

blocks.text: To find a commodity code for your goods, you’ll need details of the product you’re importing or exporting. This could include:
what the product is used for
the materials used to make it
